subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who picked Ilvara up, used the Eldritch Claw Tattoo to wrap tentacles around her, hauled her forty feet into the air, hit her twice in the ribs during the ascent, and dropped her.
source_quote: He had opened this fight by *picking Ilvara up*. Used the Eldritch Claw Tattoo to wrap tentacles around her, hauled her forty feet into the air, hit her twice in the ribs during the ascent, and dropped her.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is referenced by Zalthir as the one who looked at him with a Zuggtmoy-deep expression, something that had nothing to do with her personal opinion of Zalthir and everything to do with the demon lord wearing her face.
source_quote: And then she looked at him. And something in that look — something Zuggtmoy-deep, something that had nothing to do with Ilvara Mizzrym's personal opinion of Zalthir and everything to do with the demon lord wearing her face — *landed*.

subject: cavern
fact: The cavern contains a collapsed heart fungus, a ruined bridge, a thick spore-choked silence, and a fading prophecy about a bride.
source_quote: The heart fungus was already a collapsed ruin — Thorin had seen to that in one devastating, almost insulting round... The bridge was rubble. The poisonous bloom was already beginning to thin and drift.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced by himself as the one who fired Guiding Bolt at Ilvara, causing her body to rupture outward in a massive toxic bloom of poisonous spores.
source_quote: The bolt left my hand. It lanced across the cavern floor in a concentrated column of radiant light and found her where she stood. She did not die quietly. She detonated. Her body ruptured outward in a massive toxic bloom — a cloud of poisonous spores billowing through the cavern in every direction...

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is referenced by himself as the one who toppled the bridge, sent Ilvara and Jorlan crashing to the cavern floor, and destroyed the heart fungus with Dawnbringer in two rounds of radiant damage.
source_quote: Thorin had already toppled the bridge, sent both of them crashing to the cavern floor... The fungus, at least, was mine. Clean and total. Dawnbringer lit the thing up from the first swing and it never got a second chance.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree is referenced by Grygum as the one who dropped to her knees and began murmuring prayers to Lolth, reshaping what she'd witnessed into something her goddess could use.
source_quote: Somewhere in the settling quiet, Asha Vandree dropped to her knees and began murmuring prayers, her voice the only sound left — words to Lolth, rising from the wreckage, already reshaping what she'd witnessed into something her goddess could use.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is referenced by Thorin as the one who fired an empowered fireball through the last T'sarran mage, singeing him at the edges.
source_quote: Daz had already run an empowered fireball through him; the man was singed at the edges and blinking with the stunned expression of someone who had entered this fight expecting an easy kill and received instead a detailed education in why that assumption was wrong.

subject: Zuggtmoy
fact: Zuggtmoy is referenced by Ilvara and Zalthir as the demon lord wearing Ilvara's face, whose prophecy about the bride and chaos to come was spoken with the tone of someone who genuinely believed it.
source_quote: Something Zuggtmoy-deep... something that had nothing to do with Ilvara Mizzrym's personal opinion of Zalthir and everything to do with the demon lord wearing her face... She was still muttering. Something about Zuggtmoy. Something about the bride, and chaos, and the mayhem to come.

subject: Eldritch Claw Tattoo
fact: The Eldritch Claw Tattoo is referenced by Zalthir as the source of tentacles used to wrap around Ilvara, with fifteen feet of reach.
source_quote: Used the Eldritch Claw Tattoo to wrap tentacles around her... He had the Eldritch Claw Tattoo — fifteen feet of reach — but the distance between him and Ilvara was not fifteen feet.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is referenced by Thorin as the glowing sword that lit up the heart fungus from the first swing and pulsed once with steady warmth against his palm after the battle.
source_quote: Dawnbringer lit the thing up from the first swing and it never got a second chance... Dawnbringer pulsed once, steady warmth against my palm.

subject: Velkynvelve
fact: Velkynvelve is referenced by Thorin as the location where the bridge was toppled, the heart fungus destroyed, and the battle concluded with spores drifting and Asha praying in the dark.
source_quote: The bridge going down was my idea, technically... The fungus, at least, was mine... I stood there and let the quiet be quiet.

subject: Jorlan Duskryn
fact: Jorlan Duskryn is referenced by Grygum as the one who was torn at by Ilvara Mizzrym like a competing bad idea, having carried her rejection since he got the scar.
source_quote: I had been in observation mode — which is a polite way of saying I was watching Jorlan Duskryn and Ilvara Mizzrym tear at each other like competing bad ideas... she discarded him when he got the scar, he's been carrying that wound ever since...

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is referenced by himself as the one who stopped tallying how many times the fight relocated while he was still arriving at wherever it used to be.
source_quote: Then I thought about how much tunnel I'd crossed to reach that bridge, how many times the fight had relocated while I was still arriving at wherever it used to be, and I stopped tallying.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced by himself as the one who noted that Bahamut does not favor spectatorship and that he gets credit for positioning, not radiance.
source_quote: Bahamut does not, in my experience, favor spectatorship... Bahamut gets the credit for the radiance. I get credit for the positioning.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who asked, 'How do I not be frightened?' and concluded, 'I'm a monk.'
source_quote: "How do I not be frightened?" He had asked, because he wanted to know the timeline... "I'm a monk."

subject: tunnels
fact: The tunnels are referenced by the last T'sarran warrior as the direction he stepped back toward after witnessing the defeat of his mage, guards, and Ilvara.
source_quote: The last House T'sarran warrior looked at all of it... and stepped back toward the tunnels without urgency. "We will meet again," he said.

subject: Guiding Bolt
fact: Guiding Bolt is referenced by Grygum as the spell that lanced across the cavern floor in a concentrated column of radiant light and found Ilvara where she stood.
source_quote: The bolt left my hand. It lanced across the cavern floor in a concentrated column of radiant light and found her where she stood.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree is referenced by Thorin as the one who was still praying in the dark like she expected to be answered, and whom Thorin had seen stranger things answered.
source_quote: Asha was still praying in the dark like she expected to be answered. Maybe she would be. I've seen stranger things answered.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who teleported across the battlefield using shadow-step, hit the T'sarran mage once, and that was enough.
source_quote: He teleported across the battlefield — shadow-step, the distance closing in the space between one breath and the next — and hit the mage once, and that was enough.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is referenced by Grygum as the one who was already something other than the woman she had been, with corruption working on her for a long time.
source_quote: She was already something other than the woman she had been. The corruption had been working on her for a long time.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced by himself as the one who filed the threat from the T'sarran warrior under 'remember that name' because a threat delivered without heat is more credible.
source_quote: A threat delivered without heat is always more credible than one made in anger. I'll want to remember that name.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who stood there and accepted the condition of fear, not fighting it, because the discipline is self-administered.
source_quote: He stood there and accepted it. *I am supposed to be trying to not be near her. Right.* Not a question. Just the rule, stated plainly, applied against his own interest the way you check a knot even when you know you tied it correctly. He didn't fight the condition.

subject: Shadow-step
fact: Shadow-step is referenced by Zalthir as the method used to teleport across the battlefield and close the distance to the T'sarran mage.
source_quote: He teleported across the battlefield — shadow-step, the distance closing in the space between one breath and the next...

subject: Underdark
fact: The Underdark is referenced by Grygum and Thorin as the setting where corruption, prophecy, and divine judgment are common, and where optimism is often corrected before the equation is finished.
source_quote: I have seen enough of this Underdark to know better than to dismiss it... The Underdark has a way of correcting your optimism before you even finish the equation.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced by himself as the one who thought, 'not ideal, how big is the cloud, glad I was standing back,' after Ilvara detonated.
source_quote: Not ideal, I thought, immediately practical again. How big is the cloud? I was glad I was standing back.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who watched from across the cavern and could not move toward Ilvara, and filed it away and waited.
source_quote: He watched from across the cavern and could not move toward her and filed it away and waited.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is referenced by himself as the one who said, 'I do what I can,' after destroying the heart fungus in two rounds of radiant damage.
source_quote: I said *I do what I can* because what else do you say when you've just ruined someone's evening in two rounds of radiant damage.

subject: cavern floor
fact: The cavern floor is referenced by Thorin as the place where Ilvara and Jorlan hit after the bridge was toppled, and where the toxic bloom later spread.
source_quote: I watched them hit the cavern floor and thought: *still breathing*... The poisonous bloom was already beginning to thin and drift.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who delivered the killing blow to the T'sarran mage with a single hit after teleporting, and then straightened.
source_quote: He teleported across the battlefield — shadow-step, the distance closing in the space between one breath and the next — and hit the mage once, and that was enough. Zalthir straightened.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced by himself as the one who noted that the last T'sarran warrior said, 'Enjoy your victory for the moment,' and filed it as a threat to be remembered.
source_quote: "Enjoy your victory for the moment." I took note of that too.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who said, 'I'm a monk,' in response to someone noting his entire contribution to the fight was predicated on being in contact with the thing he was supposed to be destroying.
source_quote: This came out in response to someone noting — correctly, irritatingly — that his entire contribution to a fight was predicated on being in contact with the thing he was supposed to be destroying.

subject: Lightning Bolt
fact: Lightning Bolt is referenced by Daz as the spell fired into the cavern upon arrival, hitting nothing but open air and ambition.
source_quote: He had fired a lightning bolt into the cavern when he arrived — a dramatic entrance, the kind with real commitment — and hit nothing. Just open air and ambition.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is referenced by Zalthir as the one who was still howling, her voice ragged with desperation, filling the space with prophecy rather than offers.
source_quote: Ilvara was still on the far side of the cavern, still howling, her voice ragged with the particular desperation of someone who has run out of futures but not yet run out of throat. *Vengeance. Zuggtmoy. The bride.* All of it tumbling out between strikes and retreats.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced by himself as the one who said, 'I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them,' after being amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama.
source_quote: I'm amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama, I thought. But I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them.

subject: bridge
fact: The bridge is referenced by Thorin as the structure he toppled, causing Ilvara and Jorlan to crash to the cavern floor.
source_quote: Thorin had already toppled the bridge, sent both of them crashing to the cavern floor...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who said, 'I shall punch the mage,' without particular enthusiasm, before teleporting and hitting him once.
source_quote: *I shall punch the mage.* Zalthir said this without particular enthusiasm.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced by himself as the one who said, 'Bahamut and I understand each other,' regarding the division of credit for radiance and positioning.
source_quote: Bahamut gets the credit for the radiance. I get credit for the positioning. We understand each other, Bahamut and I.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who noted that the fear cleared at the end of his turn, the way it had been promised to, and he noted this without celebration.
source_quote: The fear cleared at the end of his turn, the way it had been promised to. He noted this without celebration.

fact: Thorin is referenced by himself as the one who said, 'Some battles you just chase until they end without you.'
source_quote: Some battles you just chase until they end without you.

source_quote: The discipline is self-administered. Always has been.

source_quote: Whatever theology she was building out of this moment, I filed it under *watch this space.*

source_quote: "I'm a monk."... A monk frozen by fear is a monk who has no tools.

source_quote: She was still muttering. Something about Zuggtmoy. Something about the bride, and chaos, and the mayhem to come. She said it in the tone of someone who genuinely believed it, which was the worst kind.
